data.gender_notes: Nikhilesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nikhilesh is derived from Sanskrit, where Ni stands for 'Lord' and Khil stands for 'Universe'. This name signifies the one who is the Lord of the Universe, and is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology. The name Nikhilesh carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nikhilesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nikhilesh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

vedic_reference.note: Nikhil means 'all' and Ish means 'Lord'. This name is derived from the Vedic scriptures, specifically the Rigveda.

historical_references.reference: The name Nikhilesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nikhil' meaning 'all' and 'Ish' meaning 'lord'. It is believed to be the name of a popular Hindu god Vishnu in his form as the preserver of the universe.
Nikhilesh was also the name of a renowned king who ruled over the ancient Indian kingdom of Magadha around the 5th century BC. He is remembered for his wisdom and just rule.
